title: NotNotes source and estate
body:
The exact historical NotNotes v0.1-dev15 package is now in Git at packages/alchemy_notnotes/ with the source files AlchemyNotNotes.cls, AlchemyNotNotesIntentions.cls and AlchemyNotNotesClustered.cls, original tests and demos, DEPENDENCY_LOCK.json and source hashes.

Source archive SHA-256: 57a7d1b09234621f20c9de5dda312b4e38140b57cb87c45f7318e59730db4488. Dependencies are explicit: ooRexx r13196, Intention Service dev7, Alchemy RTO Cluster dev4 and security authority. Git backfill is not automatic runtime acceptance. The NotNotes v0.6.2 working corpus is independently versioned documentary data.

invariants: NotNotes alone owns its document truth and revision state
Transport and UI are adapters, not document authorities
No qualification can be assumed from Git source publication

provenance.claim: Exact historical source package; not a newer runtime acceptance
